newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak Jan-July budget deficit at SKK 17.936 bln.
newsitem.headline: Slovak Jan-July budget deficit at SKK 17.936 bln.

text.p: Slovakia's state budget deficit widened to 17.936 billion crowns in the January-July period from a 13.209 billion crown shortfall in the first six months of this year, the finance ministry said on Monday.
"The overall budget deficit totalled 17.936 billion crowns at the end of July, which is in line with the forecast state budget development in 1997," the ministry said in a statement.
The budget deficit for January-July 1996 totalled 6.088 billion crowns.
The ministry said the fiscal deficit, the shortfall after deduction of the state debt repayment, totalled 6.6 billion crowns as of July 31.
"Also this (the fiscal deficit) is in line with the forecast development for this year," the ministry said. No further details were disclosed.
